name: Yoginini
tagline: A yoga teacher who can see you.
summary: Yoginini is a yoga app that watches your form through your phone camera and speaks corrections out loud, the way a teacher would across the room. Pose tracking runs on the device and video never leaves it. When you want a human, you book a real teacher by the hour.

status.note: Pre-launch. No app has shipped, no coaches are signed, no accounts exist and nothing can be purchased.

product.category: Yoga app with on-device computer-vision form correction

howItWorks.title: Learn the shape
howItWorks.detail: A short explanation of the pose, what it should feel like, and the one or two things people usually get wrong.

howItWorks.title: Prop up your phone
howItWorks.detail: We walk you through distance, height and angle the first time. Most bad sessions are framing problems, so we fix framing first.

howItWorks.title: Hold, and listen
howItWorks.detail: The camera tracks 33 points on your body and compares your joint angles to the reference. When something drifts, a calm voice says so.

includes: Live camera coaching with spoken cues
The 20-pose core library, reviewed by teachers
Every coach's published poses and sequences
Session summaries and weekly progress notes

pricing.purchasableNote: No checkout exists on this site. These are intended launch prices.

coaches.note: No coach profiles exist. The seats below are the founding cohort we are recruiting for, not people.

seats.lookingFor: Alignment for beginners. Someone who slows a shape down until it makes sense in an unfamiliar body.
The primary series, strength and inversions. Precision, and patience with how long a handstand takes to arrive.
Tired bodies and busy nervous systems. Long holds, props, and permission to do less.
Breath-led practice and meditation. Standing poses taught as places to be still.
Runners and cyclists whose hamstrings have opinions. Sequences you can finish after a long ride.
Hips and lower backs, three-minute holds, a quiet voice. For people who sit at a desk all day.

community.defaultVisibility: friends only, every scope off until enabled

principles.title: The phone watches. Nobody else does.
principles.detail: Every frame is analysed on the device and discarded. We store angles and scores, never video. A practice done in a bedroom deserves that.

principles.title: Say less.
principles.detail: One cue at a time, never off a single frame, never twice in five seconds. Silence is part of teaching. An app that will not stop talking has not understood the room.

principles.title: Safety before beauty.
principles.detail: If three things are off, you hear the one that protects your knee or your lower back. Shape can wait. Joints cannot.

principles.title: Bodies differ. Tolerances should too.
principles.detail: A tight hamstring is a starting point, not a mistake. Every pose ships in beginner, intermediate and advanced tolerances, and adapts to your own baseline.

principles.title: Humans review every pose.
principles.detail: A badly captured reference would teach thousands of people bad form. Nothing a coach records goes live until another teacher has checked it.

principles.title: Consistency over intensity.
principles.detail: Streaks with grace days, no leaderboards, no red charts. Yoga rewards the person who shows up on a dull Tuesday, and so do we.

principles.title: The machine serves the teacher.
principles.detail: The AI fills the days between classes. It hands what it learned to a human coach, who does what no model can: notice you.

faq.question: Does anyone see my camera feed?
faq.answer: No. Video is processed on your phone and discarded frame by frame. Our servers receive joint angles and scores, never images. There is nothing to watch, even for us.

faq.question: I'm a complete beginner. Will it just tell me I'm wrong all the time?
faq.answer: Every pose ships with beginner, intermediate and advanced tolerances, and over time the app scales to your own baseline. A tight hamstring is a starting point, not an error.

faq.question: What happens after the $3 trial?
faq.answer: After 14 days it becomes the $15 monthly membership. We email you two days before, and cancelling takes one tap.

faq.question: Are coaching sessions included in the membership?
faq.answer: No. Coaches set their own hourly rate, and you pay per session. Your membership gives you their published poses and sequences to practise between calls.

faq.question: Can a teacher look at my progress?
faq.answer: If you want them to. You choose which sessions, poses or your full history to send a coach for review. They see the same angles and scores the app saw, never video, and can reply with notes or a sequence to work on. Sharing is off by default and you can revoke it any time.

faq.question: Do I need special equipment?
faq.answer: A phone with a camera and somewhere to lean it. Landscape, about two metres away, roughly hip height. The app checks your framing before each session.

faq.question: Which phones?
faq.answer: iPhone first, Android shortly after. Join the waitlist and tell us which you use.

faq.question: Is Yoginini available yet?
faq.answer: Not yet. Nothing has shipped, no coaches are signed, and there is no app to download. The waitlist is the only thing that is real today.

faq.question: What exactly happens on day 14?
faq.answer: Your $3 trial becomes the $15 monthly membership. You'll get an email on day 12 with a one-tap cancel link. Cancel before day 14 and you pay nothing more.

faq.question: Is the price the same in the app and on the web?
faq.answer: Yes, $15 either way. App stores take a cut of in-app subscriptions, so subscribing on the web leaves more for building the product. We'd rather you didn't have to think about it.

faq.question: Do coaches charge extra for their poses and sequences?
faq.answer: No. Anything a coach publishes to the library is included in membership. Coaches earn from live sessions, not from gating content.

faq.question: How are coach payments handled?
faq.answer: Through Stripe. You pay per session at the coach's hourly rate; the coach receives 80% and is paid out automatically. Refunds for missed or cancelled sessions follow each coach's stated policy.

faq.question: Can I pause instead of cancelling?
faq.answer: Yes, for up to three months. Your streak is protected while paused, and your history is kept.

faq.question: When does any of this start charging?
faq.answer: Not yet. There is no app and no payment form on this site. Nothing can charge you today, and the waitlist never asks for a card.
